findings.title: Jumping from the map to a finding hidden by the reviewer filter selects nothing
findings.explanation: `showFinding` switches to the review tab and sets `store.selected`, but it ignores `store.hiddenReviewers`. If the finding's reviewers are all unchecked, the finding is not in `visible`, and the `watch(visible)` in `App.vue` immediately resets the selection to the first visible item. The user clicks a finding on the map and lands on a different one.
findings.suggestion:
Un-hide the finding's reviewers before selecting it:

```ts
store.hiddenReviewers = store.hiddenReviewers.filter((r) => !f.reviewers.includes(r));
```

rule.quote: Every popover and dropdown closes on Escape and on a click outside it.

findings.title: Reviewer filter popover doesn't close on Escape or outside click
findings.explanation: The popover is only toggled by its own button. Escape is handled by the global key handler for the map only, and there is no outside-click listener, so the popover stays open over the list until the user finds the button again.
findings.suggestion: Close it in the existing `onKey` handler on Escape, and add a `pointerdown` listener on `window` that closes it when the target is outside `.filter-wrap`.

rule.quote: Interactive elements expose their state to assistive tech (`aria-expanded`, `aria-pressed`, …).

findings.title: Filter button doesn't expose its open state
findings.explanation: The button opens a popover but has no `aria-expanded`, so screen readers can't tell whether the list is open.

findings.title: Hidden reviewers that no longer have findings can't be re-enabled
findings.explanation: `reviewerNames` is derived from the current findings. Findings never disappear during a session, so this can't happen today, but `hiddenReviewers` is never reconciled with `reviewerNames` either.

rule.quote: Colors come from the CSS variables in `styles.css`; no hard-coded colors in components.

findings.title: Checkmark color is hard-coded to white
findings.explanation: The checkmark is a data-URI SVG with `stroke='white'`, so it ignores `--accent-text`. It works with both current themes, but a light accent would make it invisible.
findings.suggestion: Use the SVG as a `mask-image` on a `::before` with `background: var(--accent-text)`.

findings.title: `active` class is bound to a number
findings.explanation: `{ active: store.hiddenReviewers.length }` works because Vue treats it as truthy, but the intent reads better as a boolean.

findings.title: Findings without reviewers can never be hidden
findings.explanation: `hidden` returns false when `f.reviewers` is empty, so such findings ignore the filter.
